analyzed_vuln.description: Stack out-of-bounds read in ParseOldAtomList due to unchecked fixed-position indexing into a short property line. The function assumes old atom-list records have sufficient length and directly reads text[4] (and in error path text[14]) without validating text.size(). When ParseMolBlockProperties misclassifies an arbitrary non-[M/A/V/G/S]-prefixed line as an old atom-list line and passes it through, a short line triggers OOB read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input reaches MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseV2000CTAB -> ParseMolBlockProperties. In ParseMolBlockProperties, the first properties line after atoms/bonds is non-empty and starts with a character other than M/A/V/G/S, so ParseOldAtomList is called. If that line is shorter than required old atom-list format (notably length <=4 for the switch on text[4], as in malformed/fuzzed mol block content), ParseOldAtomList performs an out-of-bounds read and ASan reports stack-buffer-overflow.
